clauses.scope_note: Bailian account registration and use; clause 2.1. A person in either stated category is not eligible or may be unable to use the service.
clauses.condition_explanation: is_minor_or_lacks_full_civil_capacity means the user is a minor or a person with restricted civil capacity. is_subject_to_trade_restrictions_sanctions_or_other_legal_use_restrictions means the user is an object of restrictions, sanctions, or other legal or rule-based restrictions imposed by a country, international organization, or region.

obligation_items.content: Do not register for or use the product if the user lacks the stated full civil capacity; users subject to the specified restrictions may not normally register or use the service.
obligation_items.trigger: The user is a minor or person with restricted civil capacity, or is subject to a specified trade restriction, sanction, or other legal or rule-based restriction.

clauses.scope_note: Access to the Bailian product requires the stated account and registration steps and agreement to the separately named Aliyun User Agreement and Legal Statement and Privacy Policy.
clauses.condition_explanation: Each atom denotes a stated registration or access prerequisite. The referenced agreements are external documents whose substantive terms are not supplied here.

obligation_items.content: Enter the requested account, password, and login phone number, pass verification, sign this agreement, agree to the referenced Aliyun agreements and policy, and complete the registration and login steps.
obligation_items.trigger: Before accessing the product.

clauses.scope_note: Bailian account; transfer, lending, rental, sale, gift, and inheritance are barred except under the stated alternatives.
clauses.condition_explanation: The prohibition applies unless a law expressly provides otherwise, a judicial decision permits it, or the provider or its affiliate gives written consent.

obligation_items.content: Do not transfer, lend, rent, sell, give away, or permit inheritance of the account unless one of the stated exceptions applies.
obligation_items.trigger: Any proposed account transfer, lending, rental, sale, gift, or inheritance, except where expressly permitted by law, judicial decision, or written provider or affiliate consent.

clauses.scope_note: Bailian account security; the user must notify the provider immediately upon discovering unauthorized use.
clauses.condition_explanation: unauthorized_account_use_discovered means the user discovers that another person has used the account without authorization.

obligation_items.content: Immediately notify the provider upon discovering unauthorized account use.
obligation_items.trigger: The user discovers another person has used the account without authorization.

clauses.scope_note: Bailian service use; applies to displayed service descriptions, technical specifications, workflows, and operating documents. The paragraph also allocates consequences for failure to follow the guidance.
clauses.condition_explanation: read_and_comply_with_displayed_service_materials_and_operating_guidance means carefully read and comply with the specified materials and follow the applicable operating instructions.

obligation_items.content: Carefully read and comply with displayed service descriptions, technical specifications, workflows, operating documents, and applicable operating instructions.
obligation_items.trigger: Before and during service use, where the relevant materials or instructions apply.

clauses.scope_note: Bailian service fees and service access. Prepaid service begins after order and payment; an unpaid order expires after seven days or earlier if the service sells out. Renewal payment is due at least seven days before expiry. For postpaid service, the user must comply with the displayed billing and deduction rules.
clauses.condition_explanation: service_selected_or_used means the user selects, renews, or uses the service. Fee amount and billing standard are determined by the order page and applicable displayed rules, not specified in this agreement.

obligation_items.content: Pay the selected service fees and comply with the applicable displayed postpaid billing and deduction rules; for renewal, pay at least seven days before service expiry.
obligation_items.object: Bailian service and applicable service fees
obligation_items.trigger: When selecting a paid service, using postpaid service, or renewing an expiring service; renewal timing applies if the parties wish to continue after the service period.

clauses.scope_note: Confidentiality obligation concerns the promotional activity or policy applicable to the ordered product or service. Provider may cancel the benefit and decide whether to suspend or terminate service for breach. Multiple discounts cannot be combined absent express indication or written agreement.
clauses.condition_explanation: using_service_subject_to_discount_or_promotional_policy means the user receives a promotional benefit for an ordered product or service. The no-stacking rule applies unless expressly stated otherwise or otherwise agreed in writing.

obligation_items.content: Keep confidential the promotional activity or policy applicable to the ordered product or service.
obligation_items.trigger: The user receives a promotional benefit for an ordered product or service.

clauses.scope_note: Free service or free quota may later become paid after the provider announces the policy at least ten calendar days in advance. This duty concerns subsequent use after charging begins.
clauses.condition_explanation: charge_period_begins_and_user_continues_service_use means the announced paid period has started and the user continues using the relevant product or service.

obligation_items.content: Pay for subsequent service use under the fee policy effective at that time.
obligation_items.object: Bailian service used after the free period or quota
obligation_items.trigger: The announced charging period has begun and the user continues using the service.

clauses.scope_note: The changed price applies to continued purchases after it takes effect; services purchased before the adjustment are unaffected. Provider must give reasonable advance notice, but no specific notice period is stated.
clauses.condition_explanation: new_service_price_effective means the provider's adjusted price has taken effect after reasonable advance notice.

clauses.scope_note: Payment for Bailian services. The payer must match the name registered or identity-verified on the Aliyun website.
clauses.condition_explanation: making_service_payment means paying for the service using a payment method supported by Bailian.

obligation_items.content: Use a supported payment method and ensure the payer's name matches the name registered or identity-verified on the Aliyun website.
obligation_items.trigger: When making a payment for the service.

clauses.scope_note: Bill dispute procedure; during negotiations over a timely dispute, the user must first pay the undisputed amount.
clauses.condition_explanation: disputing_a_bill means the user contests a bill. The five-business-day period runs from receipt. If negotiations fail and the user provides insufficient supporting evidence, provider system data controls.

obligation_items.content: Raise a bill dispute within five business days after receipt if contesting it, and pay the undisputed portion while the parties negotiate.
obligation_items.trigger: A bill is received; payment of the undisputed portion is required during negotiation of a timely dispute.

clauses.scope_note: Documents required for reinvoicing or issuing a red-letter invoice, with expressly stated alternative paths based on invoice status. Reissue and refund are available only after the applicable requirements are completed and subject to the stated conditions.
clauses.condition_explanation: The three alternatives depend respectively on whether the invoice was issued in the same month and not tax-certified or deducted; whether it was tax-certified or the return occurs after the issuance month; or whether the invoice has not been issued or delivered.

obligation_items.content: Return the invoice, or provide the necessary materials for issuing a red-letter invoice, according to the applicable invoice-status alternative.
obligation_items.trigger: A sales allowance, sales return, or other event requiring reinvoicing or a red-letter invoice; no documents are required if the invoice has not been issued or has not been delivered.

clauses.scope_note: Provider reserves the right to withhold service or technical support, or terminate either, until all agreed fees are paid; termination requires necessary notice. The clause also reserves a daily late-payment charge of 0.05 percent.
clauses.condition_explanation: fees_unpaid_as_agreed means any agreed service fees remain unpaid.

clauses.scope_note: The provider or affiliate may set off its due debt owed to the user against the user's payable fees after written notice. On termination for arrears, business data is retained only for the applicable buffer period, then deleted, subject to legal, regulatory, or agreed exceptions; deletion is irreversible and no continued retention, export, or return is promised.
clauses.condition_explanation: fees_unpaid_or_service_terminated_for_arrears covers unpaid fees and service or support termination for arrears. The buffer period is supplied by the applicable service-specific terms, product documents, or service description and is not stated here.

obligation_items.content: Give written notice before applying a due debt owed to the user as a setoff against fees payable under the agreement.
obligation_items.object: Due debt owed to the user and Bailian service fees
obligation_items.trigger: The user has not timely paid fees and the provider or affiliate owes the user a due debt.

obligation_items.content: Delete customer business data, including cached and backup copies, after the applicable buffer period ends, unless a stated legal, regulatory, or agreed exception applies.
obligation_items.trigger: The service or technical support has been terminated due to arrears and the applicable buffer period has expired, subject to legal, regulatory, or agreed exceptions.

clauses.scope_note: Bailian provider's express support commitments during the service term: 24/7 telephone and online ticket consultation and fault support. Fault support requires the user to report through an online ticket and excludes user-caused, force-majeure, and other matters outside provider control. Other after-sales services may be obtained for a fee.
clauses.condition_explanation: during_service_term means the ordered service remains within its service period. The stated exclusions limit the provider's fault-support commitment.

obligation_items.content: Provide 24/7 telephone and online ticket consultation and timely fault support for faults not caused by the user, force majeure, or other matters outside provider control.
obligation_items.trigger: During the service term; fault support is triggered by the user's online-ticket report and is subject to the stated exclusions.

clauses.scope_note: Prepaid service begins upon payment and runs from activation; fixed-term and package service expire as specified. User must consume package quantity within its term. Continued use after package exhaustion or expiry, without repurchase, is treated as postpaid use and charged accordingly. For postpaid service, access depends on no unpaid other amounts and sufficient account balance.
clauses.condition_explanation: paid_service_open_or_in_use includes prepaid and postpaid service. For packages, expiry occurs on the earlier of package-term expiry or exhaustion. Postpaid access is subject to the stated debt and balance conditions.

obligation_items.content: Use package service quantity within its service period and maintain sufficient account balance for continued postpaid service.
obligation_items.trigger: During the applicable package or postpaid service period; continued use after package exhaustion or expiry without repurchase is charged as postpaid use.

clauses.scope_note: Provider may perform maintenance, change or discontinue service, and terminate early in the enumerated cases. Termination grounds include mutual agreement, serious user breach, harmful network attacks affecting provider systems, inability to provide for uncontrollable reasons or legal conflict, and discontinuation after 30 days' notice with refund of prepaid unconsumed amounts. The clause does not state a cure period.
clauses.condition_explanation: maintenance_change_or_termination_condition_occurs means scheduled or unscheduled maintenance, one of the enumerated early-termination grounds, or a service change or discontinuation. The 30-day notice and unused-prepayment refund apply to the stated discontinuation path; maintenance requires reasonable advance notice. Network-attack termination may instead involve prorated service fees and return of remaining funds.

obligation_items.content: Give reasonable advance notice of maintenance that may briefly interrupt service.
obligation_items.trigger: Before maintenance that may cause a short service interruption or suspension.

obligation_items.content: Give 30 days' advance notice and refund prepaid, unconsumed amounts when terminating a service or service function under the stated discontinuation provision.
obligation_items.object: Bailian service and prepaid unconsumed fees
obligation_items.trigger: Provider elects to discontinue a service or function under clause 3.4.4(5).

obligation_items.content: Calculate fees by actual service months, prorating a partial month by day, and return any remaining amount if service is terminated under the network-attack ground.
obligation_items.trigger: Provider terminates service because attacks involving the user's website harm provider networks or servers or disrupt specified connections.

clauses.scope_note: User must pay applicable service fees. Free after-sales support is available after ordering; additional value-added technical services are optional paid services.
clauses.condition_explanation: using_or_ordering_service means the user orders or uses the Bailian service; fee details are governed by the applicable order and agreement.

obligation_items.content: Pay the applicable service fees as stated on the website and in the agreement.
obligation_items.trigger: When fees are due for ordered or used service.

clauses.scope_note: Applies to all content made using the service, including uploaded, copied, generated, stored, published, or disseminated content and account information. Provider may review inputs and results. If the user declines provider review or requests a lower review threshold, the user assumes responsibility for output safety and resulting risks.
clauses.condition_explanation: content_and_service_behavior_lawful_and_consistent_with_public_order_and_morals means conduct and content comply with applicable law, policy, public order, and moral standards; the text gives reactionary, pornographic, violent, offensive, and insulting content as examples of prohibited content. accept_responsibility_for_account_activity means all conduct under the registered account is the user's responsibility. The optional lower-review path places output-safety responsibility on the user.

obligation_items.content: Comply with the Service Use Rules and applicable law and policy, and do not input or generate prohibited harmful content.
obligation_items.object: Service use and content processed through the service
obligation_items.trigger: Whenever using the service or creating, inputting, or generating content.

obligation_items.content: Take responsibility for output safety and strengthen output review and emergency safeguards if not using provider review measures or requesting a lower review threshold.
obligation_items.trigger: The user does not use the provider's review measures or asks the provider to lower the review threshold.

clauses.scope_note: Covers information content made through the service and processed at the user's direction, including content used to generate new content. The clause states a user assurance, not a grant of rights in generated results.
clauses.condition_explanation: content_owned_by_user_or_authorized_for_processing means the user owns the information or the relevant rights holder has authorized its processing. Third-party rights include personality, copyright, and property rights.

obligation_items.content: Ensure submitted information is owned by the user or authorized by its rights holder for processing, and that directed analysis, processing, and generation do not infringe third-party rights.
obligation_items.object: Information content submitted to or processed through the Bailian service
obligation_items.trigger: Whenever the user submits content or directs the service to analyze or process it or generate new content.

clauses.scope_note: Applies to use of the service to fabricate or disseminate false information. If publishing or disseminating non-real information generated through the service, the user must conspicuously label it as required by law, with examples including a watermark or a non-real-information statement.
clauses.condition_explanation: publishing_or_disseminating_generated_non_real_information means making non-real information generated using the service public or transmitting it to others. The labeling obligation applies to that publication or dissemination condition.

obligation_items.content: Do not use the service to fabricate or disseminate false information.
obligation_items.object: Information content created or disseminated through the service
obligation_items.trigger: Whenever using the service.

obligation_items.content: Conspicuously label generated non-real information, including by adding a watermark or a statement that it is non-real.
obligation_items.trigger: When publishing or disseminating non-real information generated through the service, as required by law.

clauses.scope_note: Covers content published, uploaded, linked, or otherwise provided through the service, in any form. Provider retains authority to review and remove or block content it or a competent regulator considers unlawful or contrary to platform terms or policy.
clauses.condition_explanation: providing_content_through_service means publishing, uploading, linking, or providing content by any means through the service.

obligation_items.content: Accept responsibility for content published, uploaded, linked, or otherwise provided through the service.
obligation_items.object: Content provided through the Bailian service
obligation_items.trigger: Whenever the user publishes, uploads, links, or otherwise provides content through the service.

coverage_notes: This target contains no express patent license or sublicense grant. It provides no general permission to redistribute the service or outputs; no such permission is inferred.

The referenced Service Use Rules, order pages, product documents, Privacy Policy, Aliyun User Agreement, and service-specific buffer periods are not included in the target. Their contents and any additional conditions cannot be determined from this excerpt.
Clauses 283 and 285 make third-party model rights and additional rules dependent on separate agreements or rules; their substantive provisions are not supplied here.

paragraph_audit.reason: Reviewed the full target range. The operative account, registration, payment, confidentiality, service-use, termination, content, and labeling provisions are represented by cited clauses. Headings and signing or agreement-scope text are not independent activity constraints; external incorporated rules are identified as missing in coverage_notes.
